first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing is the most direct response to the competitor’s entry pricing and the documented price-sensitive SMB loss. Verify its archived evidence for qualified-revenue, margin, retention, and post-promotion durability before committing; verify onboarding evidence because declining completion is also a consequential, currently relevant alternative. Run only a bounded SMB-targeted experiment rather than broadly discounting until downstream value is confirmed.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment in self-serve accounts. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has verified evidence of higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), making it the strongest sustainable-growth option. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified retention decline (-12%) makes its qualified-revenue lift unsustainable. Track qualified conversion and retention alongside completion because the verified onboarding result did not directly measure qualified revenue.
